policy.name: Minimum Canonical Product Unit (MCPU)
policy.surface_rule: Annotate the shortest continuous source span that preserves the canonical affected product identity.
policy.vendor_rule: Retain an explicitly adjacent vendor when it belongs to the same continuous product noun phrase. Never cross a table column, conjunction, list item, sentence, or other non-contiguous structure to manufacture a vendor-bearing span.
policy.designator_rule: Retain Server, Gateway, Manager, Appliance, Controller, Service, Driver and similar tokens only when they are part of the official product or affected component identity; remove purely descriptive class nouns.
policy.version_rule: Exclude ordinary release versions, updates, patches and builds from the product surface. Preserve full literal CPE URIs and lexicalized generation or model tokens required for product identity.
policy.normalization_rule: Use a family-level CPE with wildcard version for ordinary prose product mentions. A non-wildcard CPE version is retained only for a full literal CPE surface or a lexicalized generation identity approved by this contract.
